title: Movie Fundraiser – Crazy Rich Asians
excerpt: The movie fundraiser will take place at Event Cinemas Garden City at 5:00 pm on Sunday, 26 August – five days before the official Australian premier!
body_html:
We are delighted to announce that the Queensland Eye Institute Foundation will be hosting an EXCLUSIVE pre-release premiere of Crazy Rich Asians, a romantic comedy-drama based on the international bestselling book by Kevin Kwan!

The movie fundraiser will take place at Event Cinemas Garden City at 5:00 pm on Sunday, 26 August – five days before the official Australian premiere! By purchasing tickets to the event, you will help supporting our goal to raise vital funds towards equipment and technology for eye health research.

You can also purchase $10 raffle tickets online for a chance to win fantastic prizes including:

  • Two economy flights from Brisbane to Singapore via Singapore Airlines, plus a 4 day/3 night complimentary stay voucher in a Quay Room at The Fullerton Hotel Singapore, inclusive of Straits Club access for two adults. This is valued over SGD 3,244 plus tours. Thank you to our generous sponsors Singapore Airlines, The Fullerton Hotel and the Singapore Tourism Board.
  • A City Lights Package valued at $479 for two for one night at the Rydges Hotel South Bank – your choice of accommodation in either a Deluxe Room or Deluxe King Suite, parking for one car and a bottle of sparkling wine on arrival, buffet breakfast in Bacchus restaurant and late check-out option at 1:00 pm. Thank you to our generous sponsor the Rydges Hotel South Bank.
  • A case (6 bottles) of GH Mumm Champagne
  • Gold Class tickets kindly donated by Event Cinemas

For further details, T&C’s and to purchase movie or raffle tickets, please click here. We hope to see you and your family/friends there!
